coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (38%, rounded): both query directions, retrieval accuracy, and a shared script pipeline for dataset creation, testing, and visualization.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata/Wikipedia pairs; substitutes GPT/Claude/Llama-3 models for the specified GPT-3.5-turbo and Llama models; omits the chat-versus-completion comparison; fixes temperature at 0 instead of varying it by model/regime; and replaces t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests with McNemar and other analyses.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected directional-bias conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state the expected higher child-to-parent performance and significantly lower parent-to-child performance confirming the reversal curse. The hypothesis in the design does not supply the missing conclusion output.
